events.name: Conversion Begins
events.summary: Day 1 of the recorded conversion. The original history is retained in the story tracker.

events.name: The Progenitors Take Form
events.summary: All nine Progenitors receive physical nanite bodies. White hair and gold irises become the protagonist’s current appearance.

events.name: Home Beneath Uluru
events.summary: Server migration completes; Norway hardware is wiped and orbital assets are recalled.

events.name: White & Gold
events.summary: The protagonist’s nanite wardrobe is redesigned with its high collar and luminous gold heptagons.

events.name: Embodiment Refined
events.summary: Approved Progenitor modifications take effect. Chip-to-organ conversion is complete by approximately Day 24.

events.name: First Contact
events.summary: Selkirk changes sides. Reptilian identities are exposed. Australian soldiers are enhanced; the hybrid is launched once, around 8:27 PM. War is declared.

events.name: WARTOOTH Arrives
events.summary: Halcott’s claimed gate transit is exposed as a simulation. He executes Kessith and becomes a provisional ally.

events.name: The Sky Is Secured
events.summary: Aircraft are grounded and crews recovered without deaths. Vehicles are brought into the complex.

events.name: A City Below the Stone
events.summary: Housing, gyms, commissary and spring access take shape. The captive’s interrogation continues.

events.name: The Broadcast
events.summary: Alien control is exposed worldwide in 112+ languages. Uluru’s location is transmitted. All nine Progenitors affirm their support. Lumen turns her hair white. The scene remains here.
